hook.line: Mariana is recording a podcast about the café, and "Vale found the letter" is too flat for her. She wants the listener to hear exactly who, where or when. In English you would lean on a word with your voice. Spanish builds a frame around it.
hook.es: Fue Rosa quien abrió este café.
hook.en: It was Rosa who opened this café.

examples.es: Fue Vale quien encontró la carta.
examples.en: It was Vale who found the letter.

examples.es: Lo que no entiendo es por qué.
examples.en: What I don't understand is why.
This is where it all began.

examples.es: Fue ayer cuando llegó la carta.
examples.en: It was yesterday that the letter arrived.

examples.es: ¿Fuiste tú quien dejó la puerta abierta?
examples.en: Was it you who left the door open?

examples.es: Lo que quiero es hablar con Mariana.
examples.en: What I want is to talk to Mariana.

examples.es: No fue Vale quien lo dijo, fue Mariana.
examples.en: It wasn't Vale who said it, it was Mariana.

rule:
To put the spotlight on one piece, Spanish builds a frame with *ser*, and the piece you want heard goes right after it.

A person: *Fue Vale quien encontró la carta.* (several people: *Fueron los vecinos quienes firmaron.*)
A place: *Es aquí donde todo empezó.*
A time: *Fue ayer cuando llegó la carta.*
A thing or an idea: *Lo que quiero es hablar con Mariana.*

So the recipe is *ser* + the highlight + *quien* / *donde* / *cuando* + the rest. With things, flip it: *lo que* + the rest + *es* + the highlight.

*Ser* usually follows the time of the story: *fue* for something finished, *es* for now. English underlines a word with its voice, "It was VALE who...". Spanish rearranges instead.
smallPrint: Teachers call these cleft sentences. The second kind, *lo que... es...*, is also called a pseudo-cleft.

readAndPick.es: Fue Vale quien encontró la carta.
options: It is Vale who finds the letter.
It was Vale who found the letter.
It will be Vale who finds the letter.

readAndPick.es: Fueron los vecinos quienes firmaron la carta.
options: It was a neighbour who signed the letter.
It will be the neighbours who sign the letter.
It was the neighbours who signed the letter.

readAndPick.es: Lo que no entiendo es por qué.
options: What I don't understand is why.
What I understand is why.
What you don't understand is why.
This is where it all ended.
This is where it all began.
This is when it all began.

readAndPick.es: Fue ayer cuando llegó la carta.
options: It was here that the letter arrived.
It will be tomorrow that the letter arrives.
It was yesterday that the letter arrived.

readAndPick.es: ¿Fuiste tú quien dejó la puerta abierta?
options: Was it you who left the door open?
Was it Vale who left the door open?
Was it me who left the door open?

readAndPick.es: Lo que quiero es hablar con Mariana.
options: What I wanted was to talk to Mariana.
What I want is to talk to Mariana.
What Mariana wants is to talk to me.

readAndPick.es: Fue en la cocina donde Vale encontró la carta.
options: It was Vale who found the letter in the kitchen.
It was the letter that Vale found in the kitchen.
It was in the kitchen that Vale found the letter.

readAndPick.es: No fue Vale quien lo dijo, fue Mariana.
options: It wasn't Vale who said it, it was Mariana.
It was Vale who said it, not Mariana.
Vale didn't say it, but Mariana did not either.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *quien* or *quienes* and type the whole sentence: *Fueron los vecinos ___ firmaron la carta.* (It was the neighbours who signed the letter.)
yourTurn.answer: Fueron los vecinos quienes firmaron la carta.
yourTurn.why: The neighbours are several people, so *quienes*.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *lo que* or *que* and type the whole sentence: *___ necesito es un tinto.* (What I need is a black coffee.)
yourTurn.answer: Lo que necesito es un tinto.
yourTurn.why: "What" at the start of a frame is *lo que*.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *fue* or *es* and type the whole sentence. It happened already: *___ ayer cuando llegó la carta.*
yourTurn.answer: Fue ayer cuando llegó la carta.
yourTurn.why: The letter already arrived, so *ser* goes into the past: *fue*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: It was Tomás who called Vale.
yourTurn.answer: Fue Tomás quien llamó a Vale.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: What I don't understand is why.
yourTurn.answer: Lo que no entiendo es por qué.
yourTurn.why: *Lo que* + what you don't understand, then *es* and the highlight.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: This is where it all began.
yourTurn.why: For a place, the frame is *ser* + the place + *donde*.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it negative and add the correction: *Fue Vale quien lo dijo.* (It wasn't Vale who said it, it was Mariana.)
yourTurn.answer: No fue Vale quien lo dijo, fue Mariana.
yourTurn.why: *No* goes in front of *fue*, and the second half names the right person.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish, to a friend: Was it you who left the door open?
yourTurn.answer: ¿Fuiste tú quien dejó la puerta abierta?
yourTurn.why: *Fuiste* matches *tú*, and *quien* still points at the person.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: What I want is to talk to Mariana.
yourTurn.answer: Lo que quiero es hablar con Mariana.
yourTurn.why: The thing you want comes last, right after *es*.

pitfalls.wrong: Fue Vale que encontró la carta.
pitfalls.right: Fue Vale quien encontró la carta.
pitfalls.why: Almost. After a person the careful choice is *quien*, which points straight back at Vale.

pitfalls.wrong: Fueron los vecinos quien firmó la carta.
pitfalls.right: Fueron los vecinos quienes firmaron la carta.
pitfalls.why: Almost. Once the highlight is plural, *quienes* and the verb are plural too.

pitfalls.right: Lo que necesito es un tinto.
pitfalls.why: Almost. To say "what" at the start, Spanish needs *lo que*, not a bare *que*.

pitfalls.wrong: Lo que no entiendo es porque.
pitfalls.right: Lo que no entiendo es por qué.
pitfalls.why: Almost. "Why" as a question is two words, with an accent on *qué*.

pitfalls.wrong: Fue Vale quién encontró la carta.
pitfalls.right: Fue Vale quien encontró la carta.
pitfalls.why: Almost. This *quien* isn't asking anything, so it has no accent.

personal: Think of someone who helped you, or something you really want right now. Say one true sentence with *Fue... quien* or *Lo que quiero es...*.
